suggestions.title: The Matrix
suggestions.description: A computer hacker discovers reality is a simulated world created by machines to subdue humanity. The Wachowskis' groundbreaking sci-fi masterpiece redefined action cinema with its revolutionary visual effects, martial arts choreography, and mind-bending philosophical questions. Starring Keanu Reeves as Neo, the film won 4 Academy Awards and became a cultural phenomenon.

suggestions.title: City of God
suggestions.description: Two boys growing up in a violent Rio de Janeiro favela take different paths — one becomes a photographer, the other a drug dealer. Fernando Meirelles' electrifying Brazilian epic portrays the cycle of violence and survival with kinetic energy, non-linear storytelling, and one of the most remarkable ensembles in cinema history.

suggestions.title: Gladiator
suggestions.description: A betrayed Roman general becomes a gladiator and seeks vengeance against the corrupt emperor who murdered his family. Ridley Scott's epic historical drama revitalized the sword-and-sandal genre with breathtaking visuals, Hans Zimmer's iconic score, and Russell Crowe's commanding Oscar-winning performance as Maximus.

shown_titles: The Good, the Bad and the Ugly
